faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: DebateLab offers a 3-day free trial with 5 AI requests per day. After that, Pro is $5/month + tax for unlimited requests and premium models.
faq.q2: What do I get with Pro?
faq.a2: Unlimited AI requests, access to premium models (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro), Active Grounding™ research, and priority support.
faq.a3: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your Settings page. You'll retain access until the end of your billing period.
faq.q4: Does the AI make things up?
faq.a4: We use Active Grounding™ technology to verify claims against real sources. Any unverified information is clearly marked as such.
faq.q5: Can I save and export my work?
faq.a5: Yes! Save cases, brainstorms, and chats to History. Export to Word, PDF, or Google Docs.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.p1: We collect information you provide when creating an account (name, email via Google OAuth) and usage data including generated content, saved items, and interaction patterns.
privacyPage.p2: Your information is used to provide and improve our services, generate AI responses, maintain your saved content, and communicate service updates.
privacyPage.p3: Your inputs are sent to third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) for processing. We do not use your content to train AI models.
privacyPage.p4: Your data is stored securely using Firebase/Google Cloud infrastructure with encryption at rest and in transit.
privacyPage.p5: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with AI providers for processing and payment processors for billing.
privacyPage.p6: You may access, export, or delete your data at any time from your account settings. Account deletion removes all associated data.
privacyPage.p7: We use essential cookies for authentication and preferences. We use analytics to improve service quality.
privacyPage.p8: DebateLab is designed for users 13 and older. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
privacyPage.p9: We may update this policy periodically. Significant changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification.
privacyPage.p10: For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at privacy@debatelab.app.

termsPage.p4: Free trials last 3 days with limited requests. Pro subscriptions are $5/month plus tax, billed via Stripe. Cancel anytime from Settings.
termsPage.p5: You may not use DebateLab for harassment, generating harmful content, academic dishonesty in violation of your institution's policies, or any illegal purpose.
termsPage.p6: AI outputs are provided as-is without guarantees of accuracy. You are responsible for verifying facts and citations before use in competitions.

termsPage.p8: DebateLab is provided as-is. We are not liable for competition outcomes, inaccurate AI outputs, or service interruptions.
